# Implementation Plan: Bio Link Page

**Branch**: `001-bio-link-page` | **Date**: 2026-06-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-bio-link-page/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `research.md` for all technology decisions and their rationale.

---

## Summary

Build a self-hosted, config-driven static bio link page — a free Linktree alternative. The owner edits a single `src/config.ts` file to set their profile (photo, name, handle, bio), an ordered list of link buttons (each with icon + label + URL), an optional row of social-network icons, a color theme, and SEO/deploy metadata. Vite builds the result into a self-contained static bundle deployable to GitHub Pages, Vercel, or Netlify. All styling follows `design-system.md`; CSS custom properties let the theme object override any color token at runtime without touching component files.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.x — `strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`, no implicit `any`

**Primary Dependencies**:
- React 18+ + react-dom
- Vite 5+
- Tailwind CSS v3 (stable; v4 migration deferred — see research.md Decision 1)
- lucide-react (tree-shaken via `ICON_MAP` registry — see research.md Decision 5)
- `gh-pages` (devDependency — deploy tooling only, not a runtime dep)

**Styling**: Tailwind CSS v3 extended with CSS custom properties mapped from `design-system.md` tokens. Theme overrides applied via `style` prop on root element.

**Storage**: None — fully static, no persistence layer

**Testing**: Vitest + React Testing Library (devDependency; targets `src/utils/` only)

**Target Platform**: Any static CDN — GitHub Pages (primary), Vercel, Netlify

**Performance Goals**: All visible content in <2 seconds on 3G (~1.6 Mbps) — implies JS bundle <100 KB gzip

**Constraints**:
- Minimum viewport 320px, mobile-first Tailwind classes
- No SSR, no server-side configuration, no runtime environment variables
- `src/config.ts` is the only file the page owner edits

**Scale/Scope**: Single-page static site, one deployment per owner

---

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Gate question | Status |
|---|---|---|
| I. TypeScript Strict Mode | All props typed via named interfaces in `src/types.ts`; `strict: true`; functional components only | ✅ PASS |
| II. Config-Driven Customization | `src/config.ts` is the only file a user edits; no value hard-coded in components | ✅ PASS |
| III. Functional Component Architecture | URL validation, icon resolution, and config sanitisation live in `src/utils/`; components only read and render | ✅ PASS |
| IV. Mobile-First & Accessibility | Base styles target 320px; `md:`/`lg:` for enhancements; all `<a>` carry `aria-label`; all `<img>` carry `alt`; design-system palette meets WCAG AA | ✅ PASS |
| V. Static Build & Deploy | Vite produces self-contained `dist/`; `base` path sourced from `config.meta.basePath`; no server deps | ✅ PASS |
| Stack Constraints | `framer-motion` removed — animations implemented via CSS `@keyframes` + Tailwind utilities (Option A, owner-approved 2026-06-13) | ✅ PASS |
| SEO Standards | `<title>`, `<meta description>`, Open Graph tags, canonical link, and JSON-LD all sourced from `config.meta` | ✅ PASS |

---

## Complexity Tracking

No active violations. Framer Motion was requested but removed (owner chose Option A, 2026-06-13). Animations implemented via `@keyframes fade-up` in `globals.css` and `animation-delay` per link index. See `research.md` Decision 2 for the full CSS pattern.

## Project Structure

### Documentation (this feature)

```text
specs/001-bio-link-page/
├── plan.md                  ← this file
├── research.md              ← Phase 0 technology decisions (9 decisions)
├── data-model.md            ← Phase 1 entity definitions and validation rules
├── quickstart.md            ← Phase 1 owner setup + deploy guide
├── contracts/
│   └── site-config.ts      ← Phase 1 TypeScript interface contract
├── checklists/
│   └── requirements.md     ← spec quality checklist
└── tasks.md                 ← Phase 2 output (generated by /speckit-tasks)
```

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
src/
├── config.ts              ← ONLY file the page owner edits (exports SiteConfig)
├── types.ts               ← re-exports all interfaces from contracts/site-config.ts
├── main.tsx               ← Vite entry; mounts <App />
├── App.tsx                ← reads config, applies theme CSS vars, renders page + <head>
│
├── components/
│   ├── ProfileCard.tsx    ← avatar + name + @handle + bio
│   ├── LinkButton.tsx     ← single prominent link button (icon + label + href)
│   ├── LinkList.tsx       ← ordered list of <LinkButton> with stagger animation
│   └── SocialIcons.tsx    ← compact icon-only row for social networks (optional)
│
├── utils/
│   ├── config.ts          ← validateConfig(): filters invalid links, applies theme defaults
│   └── icons.ts           ← ICON_MAP registry + resolveIcon() with fallback
│
├── assets/
│   └── avatar.jpg         ← default profile photo (fallback when avatarUrl fails)
│
└── styles/
    └── globals.css        ← CSS custom property defaults + @keyframes + Tailwind base

public/                    ← static assets at root (favicon.ico, og-image.jpg)
index.html                 ← Vite HTML entry; Google Fonts <link>; initial SEO <head>
vite.config.ts             ← reads basePath from config.meta.basePath for `base` option
tailwind.config.js         ← extends theme.colors with CSS-variable tokens
tsconfig.json              ← compilerOptions.strict: true
package.json               ← scripts: dev | build | preview | deploy
```

**Structure Decision**: Single Vite project (no monorepo). Business logic in `src/utils/` per Principle III. No backend, no tests folder at root — utils tests co-located as `src/utils/*.test.ts`.
